data.description:
Who We Are:
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

We put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

Diversity Matters:
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

Key Info:
  • Job title: Digital Business Analyst - APAC
  • Role type: Permanent, Full Time
  • Reports into: Digital APAC Lead
  • Location: Hybrid/Villawood, NSW
  • Ideal starting date: As soon as possible
About the Role:
This is a new role, and the first of its kind for Lush in APAC. 

You will be the link between our APAC operations and the digital teams who build and run our platforms. 

You will take a vision and will work out what it means for our systems, teams, customers and processes. You'll turn it into detailed, comprehensive plans that our dev teams can build from. 

The work will cover a mix of ecommerce and retail systems including (but not limited to!) our loyalty programme, point of sale and stock systems, web and app ecommerce platforms, manufacturing systems, and internal tools. 

This is a hands-on role that is part technical mastery and part communications expert, all with a project management flair. As well as working with stakeholders, you will spend time deep in our platforms and data, testing changes, finding ways forward, and looking into issues yourself before they reach engineering. 

This role is based in Sydney and will be working with market teams across the region as well as with Lush Digital colleagues in the UK, Europe, and North America.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Work closely with Digital leadership, stakeholders and developers to bring vision to reality 
  • Work with stakeholders across our APAC markets to determine the requirements for changes to legal, financial, technical and operational processes.
  • Create, manage and maintain detailed tickets of work for our development teams.
  • Capture, analyse and document requirements, then support communication and delivery.
  • Assess how new features and products will affect our systems, processes and data, both local and global.
  • Carry out cost-benefit analysis, including the associated risks.
  • Support administration and configuration of platforms
  • Test changes before they go live, and look into issues before escalation
  • Identify where we can use the systems and features we already have before building something new.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Experience defining solutions within a technical development environment.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, testing and troubleshooting digital platforms and integrations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to work professionally with engineers, international teams and subject matter experts.
  • Experience liaising with and managing internal and external stakeholders.
  • A highly organised, logical and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritise competing work.
  • Able to work well with a team spread across countries and time zones, hosting and joining online calls.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity with pragmatism
Our Perfect Match Is:
  • Experienced in retail or consumer brand ecommerce.
  • Familiar with ecommerce platforms such as Saleor and Adyen, and ticketing tools such as Linear or Jira.
  • Able to speak Japanese, Mandarin or Cantonese. A bonus, not essential.
  • Friendly, kind and approachable. 
  • Able to work from our Villawood office on a hybrid basis.

data.description:
Diversity matters
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

Who we are
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

The role
In this role, you’ll be the face of the store, welcoming customers and providing a fun, engaging shopping experience. You’ll use your product knowledge to offer personalised recommendations, perform product demonstrations, and hand out tailored samples. Working closely with your team, you’ll help drive sales, exceed targets, and create memorable in-store events that keep customers coming back. You'll also manage stock, ensure the shop floor looks its best, and adapt displays to seasonal trends. With flexible shifts, a competitive hourly rate based on the Living Wage, and opportunities for bonuses, you’ll be well-supported through training and development to grow your skills.

Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.

Key Information

Hours available: Range of contracts from 4 - 12 hours (with a chance for overtime)

Availability Requirement: At least 2 full days including 1 full weekend day. You will also be required to be availlable on Wednesday evenings for training. Please note, if you are in education and you haven't yet got your timetable for the upcoming academic year, please don't apply until you know your availability. 

Application Deadline: Sunday 12th December

Interview Date: Ongoing from 7th September

Training: Ongoing from 14th September

Start Date: Ongoing from 21st September

Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Greet customers warmly and create a welcoming store environment.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs, provide personalized recommendations, and offer product demonstrations.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service by using in-depth product knowledge and offering tailored samples.
  • Assist in hosting in-store events, providing a memorable and inclusive experience for customers.
  • Maintain a clean, tidy, and visually appealing shop floor.
  • Support the store’s sales targets by promoting products creatively and working as part of a team to exceed goals.
  • Manage stock levels efficiently, ensuring shelves are well-stocked and ready for our customers to shop from.
  • Actively control store costs, such as product waste, to help meet the shop’s budget.
  • Participate in ongoing training and development to enhance product knowledge and customer service skills.
  • Collaborate with the team to foster an inclusive, respectful working environment, contributing to the overall customer experience.
  • Work on in-store and external events to leave lasting impressions on customers.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
Customer Experience: Embrace a true passion for delivering exceptional customer service, inspiring your team to radiate positivity and create memorable 5-star experiences. Our stores are designed to be havens of kindness, aiming to make every customer's day unforgettable. As a Sales Assistant, your vibrant role significantly contributes to infusing this warmth into every customer interaction.

Teamwork: Fill the shop floor with positivity, teaming up with your colleagues to achieve goals and cultivate a work environment that nurtures continuous team growth. Your role as a Sales Assistant revolves around making teamwork an instinctive and joyful experience.

Communication: Great communication should be part of your daily routine, ensuring information effortlessly circulates throughout the store. Foster collaboration with colleagues, your manager, and nearby stores by keeping communication open and respectful.. As a Sales Assistant, your knack for maintaining a positive and approachable communication flow contributes uniquely to the team's success on the shop floor.
